competitor_signals.signal: Heavy Trustpilot presence with 28-29 verified reviews, positioning as premium $1,000/mo enterprise tool with personal sales team & Meta ad management
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Shiftly is doubling down on enterprise narrative with strong social proof on review platforms, leveraging 1000+ dealer customer base to build trust
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Listing your cars shouldn't cost $1,000/mo. Ventrix posts to FB Marketplace instantly—no enterprise price tag, no sales demo required. Chrome extension + auto-fill = done in seconds.

competitor_signals.signal: Launched 90-day testing campaign (Jan 2026) across 12 dealerships; published comparative testing results claiming 3.2x more engagement from AI video vs photo-only posts
competitor_signals.what_it_means: CARVID is aggressively building credibility through third-party-style testing and video differentiation; targeting multi-platform + video-first positioning
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Not everyone needs 9 platforms. Ventrix owns the Chrome extension marketplace listing workflow—fast, simple, focused. Video is a bonus, not a requirement to win.

competitor_signals.signal: Launched in Feb 2026 with AI-powered automation and 80% time reduction claim; UK-founded SaaS, now expanding to US market
competitor_signals.what_it_means: New entrant entering US market with aggressive positioning; claims 80% time reduction and multi-platform import capability (AutoTrader, Cars.com, CarGurus)
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix was already here. Chrome extension + instant auto-fill beats any new SaaS onboarding. Dealers want zero friction, not more software dashboards.

competitor_signals.signal: Recently touting team dashboards, per-rep tracking, and 429+ active dealers with zero bans; $99/mo individual vs $799/mo dealership tier
competitor_signals.what_it_means: AutoLister Pro is emphasizing team management + accountability features; competing on transparency (published pricing) and lean sales (under 30 sec per listing)
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix's per-rep analytics work inside the Chrome extension where salespeople already work. No context-switching. No dashboard login friction.

competitor_signals.signal: Selling $129/mo on Whop marketplace; 2 verified reviews on Whop—both 1-star (1.0 avg rating); heavy affiliate program promotion (20% recurring)
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Shiftly's affiliate-heavy channel strategy is backfiring with terrible review signal on Whop; trust gap between Trustpilot testimonials and actual user experience
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix doesn't hide behind affiliate noise. Show real dealer wins + zero-affiliate transparency. Dealers buy tools that work, not affiliate programs.

competitor_signals.signal: CARVID published May 2026 guide highlighting stricter Meta enforcement: 30-day instant bans (up from 7 days), zero warning system, permanent bans on 2nd violation within 90 days
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Compliance concerns are top-of-mind in market; CARVID using ban prevention as feature differentiation (73+ dealerships, zero bans claim)
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix compliance messaging: 'Built for dealerships, compliant by design.' Simple rate limiting + human-mimic posting intervals. Dealers want assurance, not anxiety.

competitor_signals.signal: Positioned as photography + 360° spin tool vs multi-platform poster; CARVID vs Glo3D comparison page (May 2026) shows Glo3D lacks video, automation, and social posting features
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Photography-first tools are losing ground to automation + video; Glo3D seen as niche photo enhancement, not a posting solution
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix is the opposite: posting-first with photo/video flexibility. Dealerships don't need 360 spins; they need listings live NOW.

competitor_signals.signal: Cheapest option at $99/mo but lacks ban protection, video, automation; CARVID/others position Lazy Poster as 'test & outgrow' tool for dealers
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Budget segment is being classified as high-risk (ban exposure); market pushing dealers toward mid-tier automation tools
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix: Premium feature set (auto-fill, per-rep tracking, compliance) at Lazy Poster price point. Best-in-class Chrome extension + dealership-grade features.
